_comment: Small illustrative offline snapshot for the seeded stand. For real use point scan_dependencies at an osv-scanner offline database (osv-scanner --offline-vulnerabilities --download-offline-databases) or pip-audit; this file is only the zero-dependency fallback.

vulns.summary: Session cookie may be cached by a proxy and served to another client (missing Vary: Cookie).
Arbitrary code execution via full_load / FullLoader on untrusted YAML.
xmlattr filter allows keys with spaces, enabling attribute injection (XSS).
Proxy-Authorization header leaked to destination on HTTPS redirect.
Unbounded multipart form parts allow resource exhaustion.
Cookie header not stripped on cross-origin redirect.
